capabilities.name: Health Domain Knowledge and Semantic Gap Registry
capabilities.responsibility: Represent Health-domain knowledge maturity, product-semantic maturity, claim-aspect plane placement and unresolved semantic blocking states while permanently preserving unknown semantic-variant space as open.
capabilities.authority_role: Disconnected descriptive gap-governance contract only; it cannot establish product facts, resolve instance evidence, certify product semantics, claim domain completeness, or authorize an answer.
safety_invariants: Domain-knowledge maturity and product-semantic maturity remain separate axes.
Unknown semantic-variant space is permanently open and cannot be marked closed.
A product semantic record carries exactly one of a maturity state or a blocking state.
Domain knowledge may support only general explanation; when a resolved policy/customer instance is in scope, product or operational evidence must govern the answer.
capabilities.notes: Executable HC-1.0 contract with substantive invariants but no current runtime importer. Governed as DISCONNECTED rather than falsely presented as active runtime authority.
